name: claude-mods
description: A collection of small mods for Claude Code.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Optional, off by default. Picks the model from the first prompt of a session and the effort on each prompt; the model only moves up when a later prompt needs it. Gives each subagent its own model and effort.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Compact one-line usage: session and week with percent, progress ring and time to reset, context fill, session cost and a prompt-cache countdown.

plugins.name: workspace
plugins.description: A side pane titled Agents with the sessions and agents running on the machine; a click opens that chat.

plugins.name: usage-report
plugins.description: Usage across every session on the machine, today or the last 7 days: tokens, cache hit, estimated cost, models, top sessions, tool calls ok and failed, retries, API errors. Open it with /report.

plugins.name: usage-advisor
plugins.description: Watches how a session spends tokens and shows an `A` at the end of usage-bar's line, light orange and dimmed when no tip applies. A click, or /advisor, opens an audit of the project: preload, last 10 sessions, diagnosis, changes to approve one at a time, and habits.
